conviction_note: Two offsetting company-level reads (a strong H1 order book with high-margin projects pushed into H2 and a machine-tool upcycle, against a Q3 that has been a loss quarter and was sold in both prior years, plus guide-cut risk on a stretched OP plan, into a crowded margin long) net to about zero. Findings sum -0.10 and the scaled number is (2*0.48-1)*7.0 = -0.28; both say no real edge on direction. abs_move is kept above the 6.27 proxy because this is a retail theme stock (YTD 441 to 2,710 yen, 60d vol 71%) whose last two prints moved +18-19% and -11.8%.
bar: Company FY11/2026 plan as revised 2026-07-13: revenue 36,000m, OP 500m, ordinary 300m, NP 100m yen, implying H2 OP 589m / ordinary 387m (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6217&b=k202607130004). No analyst coverage at all (kabuyoho: 0 analysts, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=6217) and no 四季報/IFIS number was found, so the bar is the company plan only, which is unsourced as a market number and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (baseline, as of 2026-09-29). Margin: 信用買残 324,500 shares vs 信用売残 0 as of 2026-10-02 (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/6217.T), about 4.8% of 6.81m shares outstanding and roughly 6 days of 20d turnover; irbank shows the long balance built from ~120k in May to 305k by 2026-07-17 (https://irbank.net/6217/margin), i.e. much of it was bought during the April-June 'physical AI'/glass-cloth spike far above today's price. Crowded, underwater margin long, zero short: the setup where a weak print still has sellers and a strong one has no short squeeze to fuel it. No options, no skew. Price: -9.8% 20d, -12.6% 5d, and -5.3% intraday at the 10:05 seal (697 yen, Nikkei -2.2% the same morning).

findings.finding: H1 orders were 23,108m yen (+28.1% yoy; textile +27.3%, machine tool +32.6%) and the company said high-margin projects slipped from Q2 into H2, with H2 revenue planned at 19,475m (+7.8% yoy), so Q3 (Jun-Aug) faces a very weak base (Q3 FY25 OP -185m, ordinary -178m) and a yoy 'loss narrowed / back to profit' headline is the likelier print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (2026-04-13, 15:00) printed a narrowed quarterly loss (OP -134m vs -276m) and the stock went limit-up, 445 to 525 (+18%) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6217&b=n202604140126); that was inside a theme spike, so it overstates the line's normal pull.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the backlog has been public since July, and the stock has fallen about 14% from 807 (2026-09-25) into the print with no analyst modelling the quarter. If the market expected a Q3 yoy improvement, the stock would not be making new lows on the day of the print. The improvement also lands inside the company's own 'H2 as planned' guide, which keeps the size small.
findings.independence: Quarterly base from kabutan's 3-month table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6217), a different document from the same company data. Same source as the guide-risk finding below for the H2 plan.

findings.finding: Japanese machine-tool orders rose 65.4% yoy in August 2026 (JMTBA preliminary, the strongest since Oct 2021; YTD +40.9%), which feeds Tsudakoma's NC rotary-table segment, the one that earned most of H1 segment profit (OP 354m vs textile 112m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print where the segment line alone moved the stock; the H1 segment beat (+113% OP) went into a -11.8% reaction driven by the FY guide cut.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an industry series the whole market has, so mostly priced at the sector level. The read-through to a 4.75bn-yen mid-cap with no coverage is only made when its own segment table prints. It is a proxy, and the segment is only about 20% of revenue, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The company's own H1 tanshin said US auto/aerospace/data-centre and China robot demand were lifting rotary-table enquiries (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260703587633.pdf).

findings.finding: Q3 is structurally this company's loss quarter (OP -19m in FY24, -185m in FY25), and both prior Q3 prints were followed by declines (about -6.4% and -4.4% on the baseline's estimated dates). With H1 OP at -89m, the 9-month progress against the 500m OP plan will read negative and imply a Q4 above any recent Q4 (501m FY24, 252m FY25), in a stock with a going-concern note and a crowded margin long.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY24 (released 2024-10-11): -6.36%. Q3 FY25 (released 2025-10-09): -4.38% (baseline, estimated cadence dates).
findings.why_not_priced: The seasonal pattern and progress rate can be computed by anyone from the last tanshin, so much of it is in the 17% slide from 807 into the print. What remains is that 324,500 margin-long shares (0 short) are holders who must eventually sell, and they will meet a printed negative 9-month number.
findings.independence: Margin balance from Yahoo Japan (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/6217.T, 2026-10-02), a different source from the quarterly table.

findings.finding: The FY OP plan of 500m needs H2 OP of 589m, about 8.8x last year's H2. The company revises at Q2 or in late December (22/12/22, 24/12/24, 25/12/23) and has not revised at a Q3 print since 2021/10/13, so a cut at this print is a minority outcome, but it would be the largest single mover if it came.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-13 guide cut (OP 700m to 500m) at the H2 print: -11.8% next session, then +74 yen (+10.6%) the session after (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6217&b=n202607160115). 2026-06-26 H1 pre-release miss: fell into the close.
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst publishes a number below the plan, so the market has no explicit marked-down bar; a cut would be news. Weighted by the company's own record of not revising at Q3, the expected value is small, and holding the plan is mildly relieving.
findings.independence: Revision dates and amounts are confirmed by the 2026-07-13 修正 notice (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6217&b=k202607130004). This shares the H2 plan arithmetic with the first finding.

outside_window.finding: FY plan likely tested at the customary late-December revision or the January full-year print (with a new mid-term plan after 中期経営計画2026 ends); going-concern note resolution depends on it

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at Q3 by the company's own record (none since 2021), but the plan is stretched, so it is a tail risk. Returns: none (no dividend, going-concern note). New-year guide: not this print (Q3). Quarter: Q3 is seasonally a loss; the 9M progress will read negative as in FY24/FY25, and the yoy comparison against the -185m Q3 FY25 base is the likelier positive headline.

rejected_candidates.detail: The same 今村証券 report states Tsudakoma's exports are mainly yen-denominated and its FX effect is limited, so there is no transmission to size

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.49 (run-up mean reversion) and the stock is down 12.6% over 5 days and 5.3% more intraday into the print. My findings net to about -0.1, so they neither confirm the lean nor fight it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held FY plan plus a yoy 'loss narrowed or back to profit' Q3 headline on a strong backlog, which drew a limit-up in April; I looked for it and filed it at +0.8.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the Q3-seasonal / 9M-progress negative rests on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last tanshin, so it shrank from -1.2 to -0.7 and p_up moved from 47 to 48; the guide-cut finding was left at -0.5 because a cut is something the release would ADD
Rule 2: two positives and two negatives, so the sign balance was not tilted; the strongest positive (held plan plus a yoy improvement headline) was searched for and is filed
